authority: Direct user request to make reviewed fixes permanent without weakening security checks; independent exact-source acceptance required.
scope: The same five exact source-fixed copies of braces3.0.3 and node-forge1.4.0. No renamed packages, relabelled versions, generic advisory exceptions or native graph changes.
controls: Independent external receipt SHA256 binds exact clean HEAD, record, policy, implementation, native and release preparation identities.
Every release checks full installed package trees, all five physical copies, exact registry preimages/postimages, locks and native inputs.
Every release fetches official advisory meaning, exact upstream revision/status and latest published package version/integrity without cached acceptance. Lookup failures block release.
Full raw audits remain visible. Only the two pinned GHSA roots can be covered by their exact proven source fixes. Any new or uncovered advisory blocks release.
Runtime, provisioning, source/receipt and invalidation regressions must pass on every mobile release and Netlify build, before publication.
Official published version changes, patch revisions/status, advisory meaning, source/native identity or maintenance-policy changes require fresh review and compatibility checks.
There is no calendar renewal. A passing maintained-fix verification is required for each release; historical temporary approval cannot authorise this mode.
limitations: These are locally maintained source fixes, not official package releases or a clean full registry audit.
Fix ownership and future security maintenance remain necessary. New security evidence can still block releases.
No app feature, publisher path, production data, store binary or handset-acceptance change is approved by this policy.
